elements.manual_reason: No candidate box isolates the mouse cursor; it ends inside b01 (the Modeling row), which is used for the row highlight.
elements.label: Mouse cursor travelling down the side menu from the logo to Modeling
Menu rows Home to Formulas taking a darker hover highlight one after another as the cursor passes
Modeling menu row hover highlight where the cursor settles

pattern.description: The cursor sweeps down the open blue navigation drawer; each row it crosses darkens briefly as a hover state, ending on Modeling, while the Reports submenu stays open.
pattern.why_premium: The hover trail shows the viewer exactly where the next action is coming from, so the menu path stays readable without zooms or callouts.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: gsap.to('.cursor', {y: rowY('Modeling'), duration: 0.9, ease: 'none'}); for each row the cursor crosses, tl.set(row, {backgroundColor: hoverBlue}, t).set(row, {backgroundColor: baseBlue}, t + rowDwell) as instant toggles (no tween); the last row (Modeling) keeps the hover colour.
build_hint.remotion: Cursor y = interpolate(frame, [0, 27], [logoY, modelingY]) linear; hovered row index = rows.findIndex(r => cursorY within r); row background = index === hovered ? hoverBlue : baseBlue (hard switch, no spring).

notes: Screen-recorded hover states rather than authored motion; the energy spikes are the row highlight toggles. The cursor has no candidate box, so it uses a manual box. No SFX candidates.
